title: Lamb Kababs, Shirazi Salad & Herb Aioli

ingredientSections.heading: Lamb Kabab
items: ½ Cup Parsley (picked from the stem)
1 Tbsp Crushed red pepper or chilli flakes (optional)

ingredientSections.heading: Shirazi Salad
items: ¼ Cup Parsley (picked from the stem)

methodSections.heading: Lamb Kabab
steps: If using bamboo or wooden skewers, soak in water for 20 minutes prior to skewering.
Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend to a smooth paste. Cover the mixture in a bowl and let chill in fridge for 30 minutes.
Measure the chilled mixture into roughly 70g portions and form onto one end of each of the skewers.
Grill the skewers rotating every 2-3 minutes until desired doneness is reached. Using a probing thermometer medium is 70°C (160°F), medium-well is 75°C (165°F) and well-done is 80°C (175°F).
Serve with Shirazi Salad and Lemon Herb Aioli and your favourite flat bread.

methodSections.heading: Shirazi Salad
steps: Remove the seeds from both the roma tomatoes and cucumbers and finely dice along with the red onion and place in a bowl.
Finely chop the parsley and combine into mixture.
Add vinegar, lemon juice, salt and pepper to the salad. Mix well and serve.

methodSections.heading: Lemon Herb Aioli
steps: Juice and zest the lemon. Mince the garlic. Whisk all the ingredients together in a bowl until everything is well combined.
